reddit.title: Introducing Ranks That Turn and March in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share our latest development update for Provincia: Ranks That Turn and March! This update addresses some key mechanics in our colony battles, ensuring that soldiers move and attack more realistically. No more teleporting units or awkward formations. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ranks-that-turn-and-march?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ranks-that-turn-and-march

steam.title: New Update: Ranks That Turn and March
steam.body: We're pleased to announce a significant update for Provincia: Ranks That Turn and March! This update refines the movement and attack mechanics in our colony battles, ensuring that soldiers move in formation without any teleportation or awkward positioning. Dive into the details and see how these changes will enhance your gameplay!
